description.content: Alua Suites Las Rocas is the perfect choice for an unforgettable holiday experience in Cala D’or, one of Majorca’s most popular resorts. Cala D’or is situated in the southeast of the island, on the seafront with spectacular views. It is an Ibizan style tourist village with sandy beaches and pine trees right up to the water’s edge. Alua Suites Las Rocas has perfect facilities to offer guests and enjoyable romantic or family holiday in a peaceful area, with car parking available near the hotel. We guarantee fun, entertainment for all ages, quality cuisine, child safety and spacious rooms
Includes 4-star hotels, 4-superior and 4 de luxe, boutiques, villas, historic hotels, rural hotels, lodges, farmhouses, resorts and portuguese pousadas.
